question_en:
I am preparing a set of labels for a watch exhibition introducing non-traditional time display methods. The attachment shows a wristwatch. Please answer the following questions:

1. What are the brand and full name of the wristwatch in the image? Which international watch award did it win? Please specify the name of the award ceremony, the year of the award, and the specific prize.
2. Taking all shortlisted wristwatches in the same award category from that edition of the ceremony as the scope, examine the front-view images of the watches published on the official website one by one. Which wristwatches have no independent circular sub-dial with a complete scale ring visible on the front dial? Please provide the brand, name, and official reference number for each such wristwatch.

Answer format: Please answer in numbered points (1)—(2); provide the watch and award information in text for Question 1; list all matching watches with their brand, name, and official reference number in a table for Question 2.
answer:
(1) Brand: Massena LAB; Full Name: Chronograph Monopoussoir Sylvain Pinaud x Massena LAB; Award Ceremony: Grand Prix d’Horlogerie de Genève (GPHG); Award Year: 2024; Prize: Chronograph Watch Prize.

(2)

| Brand | Name | Official Reference Number |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Angelus | Instrument de Vitesse | 0CHBS.I01A.V010S |
| Louis Vuitton x Rexhep Rexhepi | LVRR-01 Chronographe à Sonnerie | WAPT11 |
| TAG Heuer | Monaco Split-Seconds Chronograph | CBW2181.FC8322 |
